newsitem.title: UK: Standard Life says investment chief to leave.
newsitem.headline: Standard Life says investment chief to leave.

text.p: British Standard Life confirmed Monday that chief investment manager John Thomson was to leave the company.
"I have accepted John's decision to leave with regret as he has served the company well for 15 years," said group chief investment manager Sandy Crombie.

"He leaves at a time when the Standard Life Group is developing its investment division to compete directly with global fund management operations. This obviously requires that our first class investment team moves forward together to implement our agreed development strategy," he said.
Earlier Monday a source close to the company told Reuters that Thomson was dissatisfied that plans for change had not been implemented.

"He wanted to create a separate investment company to compete against the likes of Mercury Asset Management, but Standard Life wouldn't go along with it," said the source, who declined to be identified.
Mutual insurance company Standard Life has 52 billion stg funds under management. - James Saft, London newsroom + 171 542 2734
